propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling at 32767 chars, but Jira Data Center's jira.text.field.character.limit is admin-configurable (range 0 to 2147483647), causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit
comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but shorter than the configured limit are truncated, creating permanent divergence between local and remote bodies

sanitize_comment incorrectly reuses the description fitter fit_outbound, coupling comment truncation to description fitting logic which could have different constraints (e.g., ADF-size-based on Cloud)
the constant WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT is incorrectly attributed to Cloud comment limits rather than to jira.text.field.character.limit, reversing actual causality

the Data Center comment ceiling must be made configurable with default 32767, cited to jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519, to enable operators with non-stock instances to set the correct limit
comment and description truncation must be decoupled so future changes to description fitting cannot retarget comments
